limits: No iPhone runtime, actual GPU timing test or screenshot of new effects available in this session. Device stability, event coverage, visual result and performance require installation testing.
Thermal state is a system severity level, not a Celsius sensor reading.
CPU 100% means one fully occupied core; a multithreaded process may exceed 100%. It is this app process, not whole-device CPU utilization.
GPU milliseconds measure sampled completed presenting-command execution including added reflection work; they are not whole-device GPU utilization percentages.
Frame milliseconds are the mean presented/submitted frame interval. Render shows the Metal drawable pixel dimensions.
Damage feedback follows health samples at nominal 200ms intervals, with a one-second stable-scene guard; it does not read every engine hit event.
Shop or other UI transition coverage depends on whether scene/UI/input state changes are exposed by this build. Unknown states do not invoke game UI functions.
Branding targets the identified intro and title logo objects. Other resource-pack variants may use different names; diagnostic branding match counters expose misses.
Original assets, legal notices and game flow remain unchanged; the requested identified logo visuals are suppressed at runtime.
